content.text: No exclusivity binding Customer exists; § 1 expressly disclaims it. Submitting a compliant finding.

input.quote: Nothing herein is intended nor shall be construed as creating an exclusive arrangement between Customer and Kubient. This Agreement will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties.
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation on AP. Section 1 (p0001) affirmatively disclaims any exclusive arrangement and confirms AP remains free to offer Inventory through other agents or sell it directly to third parties, which satisfies the preferred position. I checked every other candidate: the "exclusive" references at p0002 (non-exclusive licence to AP), p0064 (exclusive forum), p0065 (each Party's own marks), p0072 (entire agreement) and p0073 (no third-party beneficiaries) are unrelated to exclusive dealing, and no requirements-purchase, sole-source, right-of-first-refusal or "shall not procure from any third party" language appears. Section 5 (p0023) makes Kubient responsible, absent contrary Exhibit terms, for contracting with all Advertisers on AP's behalf, but that is a default allocation of Kubient's own duties, is overridable in an Exhibit, and is expressly subject to AP's retained freedom in Section 1, so it does not create exclusivity. No redline proposed.
